run_check_support_list: run the check_support_list script to verify all diffusers classes are documented
read_documented_classes: read documented class names from a markdown doc file using autodoc regex
read_source_classes: read class names from a Python source file with optional exclude conditions
check_documentation: check if all source classes are documented and return undocumented class names
review_check_support_list: review the check_support_list script to add new documentation check categories
